purpose: Auditable source registry for the state-versus-media comparison. broadcaster_control records who edits the outlet's content (STATE_CONTROLLED, PUBLIC_SERVICE_INDEPENDENT, PRIVATE_INDEPENDENT), kept separate from source_layer (who communicated the item) and from categories/framing_codes (what the item argues) for the same audit reason those two are already kept apart.

sources.access_constraints: The RSS feed itself is not a complete historical archive for 1 January to 18 August 2026, and a direct automated fetch of the liveblog page was blocked (SITE_BLOCKED) from this environment. The 12 items currently loaded were supplied by the user directly (pasted page content from their own browser on 2026-09-14) and paraphrased manually, covering the primary event date (28 Feb-1 Mar 2026); they are not a complete transcript of the liveblog, which itself ran to 90+ dated entries that day alone.
sources.notes: ARD-aktuell is editorially independent under German public-broadcasting law (Rundfunkstaatsvertrag), distinct from state-directed broadcasters. Same manual-pilot pattern as DE_ZDF_HEUTE_NEWS_RSS: real, paraphrased, user-supplied content, not an automated crawl.

sources.access_constraints: Only lawfully obtained transcripts with documented programme dates may be imported; no automated video-platform scraping is performed.
sources.notes: CSV schema: published_at, programme, title, transcript, url and optional presenter.

sources.access_constraints: ZDF is editorially independent under German public-broadcasting law, like ARD-aktuell/Tagesschau. A genuine RSS feed URL was confirmed via a live fetch of the liveblog page footer on 2026-09-14 (feed_url above), but the 8 items currently loaded were still located and paraphrased manually from a direct page fetch of the Iran/Israel/US liveblog, not pulled automatically through that feed; the feed itself is general ZDF news, not scoped to this conflict, and would need query/topic filtering plus deduplication logic before it could replace manual curation.
sources.notes: Registered alongside Tagesschau as a second, independently-run German public broadcaster for cross-checking. The liveblog itself is a rolling live-updated page (18+ dated entries observed on a single fetch, 12-13 Sept 2026), not a stable historical archive; entries have no individual permalinks, so all documents from it share the liveblog's own URL as their source url.

sources.access_constraints: CBS News is a commercially owned, editorially independent broadcast news division (Paramount Global), unlike the state-controlled outlets in this registry. The one item currently loaded was located and verified manually via web search, not through an automated feed pull.
sources.notes: Distinct from the not-yet-automated US_TV_NEWS_ARCHIVE_CAPTIONS connector; this entry covers the network's own published web article text, not closed-caption broadcast transcripts.

sources.source_name: Internet Archive TV News Archive (closed-caption search)
sources.access_constraints: Free, closed-caption-based search of major US cable/broadcast news since 2009, explicitly built for quoting/research use (non-consumptive, fair-use oriented). Full historical query is possible for Jan-Aug 2026, unlike ordinary outlet RSS feeds, but requires the TV News Archive/TV 2.0 API rather than a generic RSS or HTML-listing adapter; no such API client exists in this codebase yet, so this connector is not automated.
sources.notes: Covers major US cable and broadcast networks (CNN, Fox News, MSNBC, ABC, CBS, NBC, PBS NewsHour) as independently, commercially or nonprofit-edited outlets, not government-directed. A dedicated adapter (e.g. TvNewsArchiveSourceAdapter) would need to call the documented TV News Archive search API with a date range and query, then store each returned caption snippet as a versioned raw document the same way the existing adapters do.

sources.access_constraints: CGTN is the international arm of China Central Television (CCTV), operating under the Central Propaganda Department of the Chinese Communist Party. Like the Tagesschau RSS source, the current feed is not a complete historical archive for 1 January to 18 August 2026; only a current, rolling window of items is available without a paid archive/search product.
sources.notes: Deliberately classified STATE_CONTROLLED rather than NEWS-as-independent-press: in China, broadcast and online news are state-directed by design, which is analytically the point for this project's question of how a government steers domestic and international audiences, not a reason to exclude the source.

sources.access_constraints: cgtn.com publishes a dedicated 'Transcript' section for some broadcast segments, discoverable the same way the existing HtmlListingSourceAdapter discovers IL/CN/IR state-organ releases, but no listing-page adapter for this specific section exists yet; the one item currently loaded was located and verified manually via web search, not through an automated crawl.

A direct automated fetch of this page was blocked (SITE_BLOCKED) from this environment. The 12 items currently loaded were supplied by the user as a Word document export of the page (their own browser access) on 2026-09-14 and paraphrased manually; they cover 4-13 September 2026 and are not a complete transcript of the ticker, which itself runs to hundreds of dated entries back to the war's start.
sources.notes: RND (Redaktionsnetzwerk Deutschland) is part of the privately owned Madsack Mediengruppe, editorially independent of the German state; classified PRIVATE_INDEPENDENT, distinct from the PUBLIC_SERVICE_INDEPENDENT ARD/ZDF sources already in this registry, giving Germany coverage across both broadcaster_control types alongside the US (private) and China/Iran (state-controlled) sources.

sources.access_constraints: The search results page itself is a client-side Google Custom Search widget (URL hash fragment), which a plain page fetch cannot read; individual article URLs found via a real-time web search were fetched directly and worked. The 6 items currently loaded were located and paraphrased manually via targeted searches and direct article fetches, not a systematic site crawl, and are not representative of the outlet's full Iran-war coverage volume.
sources.notes: Israel National News (Arutz Sheva) is a privately owned, religious-Zionist/national-religious oriented outlet, editorially independent of the Israeli government (not state media); classified PRIVATE_INDEPENDENT. This is the first genuinely Israeli-published source in the registry, closing a gap the rest of this registry had left completely open.

sources.access_constraints: Free, no authentication required, supports genuine historical startdatetime/enddatetime queries unlike the RSS sources in this registry, so it can retroactively cover 1 January-18 August 2026. Returns only article metadata (title, url, domain, seendate, sourcecountry, language), never full text; GdeltSourceAdapter (src/data_access/gdelt_source_adapter.py) discovers candidate articles, and a second pass with HtmlDocumentFetcher is required to retrieve full content, the same two-stage pattern already used for the state-organ sources.
sources.notes: Implemented and unit-tested against mocked HTTP responses (tests/test_gdelt_source_adapter.py), but never executed against the real GDELT API: this environment has no outbound network access. Do not treat as verified until someone with network access runs it once and confirms the live response shape still matches what the adapter parses. GDELT's own 'sourcecountry' field is a plain English country name, not an ISO code; the adapter maps only the five countries this project focuses on (see GDELT_COUNTRY_NAMES_BY_ISO), so articles from other countries are still returned but left with source_country_code=None rather than guessed at.

sources.access_constraints: Press TV is wholly owned by IRIB, Iran's sole legal broadcaster, directly overseen by the Supreme Leader's office. The live RSS feed itself is not a historical archive for 1 January to 18 August 2026; the one item currently loaded was located and verified manually via web search, not through an automated feed pull, and is a small pilot sample rather than a continuous crawl.
sources.notes: Deliberately classified STATE_CONTROLLED for the same reason as the CGTN sources: this is the most direct available signal of official Iranian messaging direction, not an independent press outlet, and should never be presented as such.
